recommended_action: Same supplier invoice booked twice; delete duplicate voucher and reverse any ITC claimed on it.
Not in GSTR-2B: ITC cannot be claimed now (s.16(2)(aa)). Follow up supplier to file GSTR-1/IFF; claim in the period it appears in 2B, within s.16(4) limit.
Values differ: claim the lower of books and 2B; get supplier to amend or pass debit/credit note.

Supplier charged IGST on an intra-state supply. Do not claim; ask supplier to issue CN and fresh invoice with CGST+SGST. Mark Pending/Reject in IMS before 2B is regenerated. IMS: no action taken - record will be deemed accepted on filing 3B. Take an explicit action.
Blocked credit (Ineligible-17(5)(b)); do not claim (report in 4D(1) if shown in 2B).
You rejected this invoice in IMS; do not claim ITC. Reverse the purchase voucher or obtain a fresh/corrected invoice.
Time limit u/s 16(4) expired on 2025-11-30; ITC lapses. Expense the tax. IMS: no action taken - record will be deemed accepted on filing 3B. Take an explicit action.
Supplier unpaid beyond 180 days of invoice date: reverse ITC with interest in 3B Table 4B(2); re-claim on payment (s.16(2) second proviso, Rule 37).
Invoice number variant: confirm document before claiming; ITC shown assumes confirmation.
Supplier credit note in 2B not booked: book the debit-side entry and reduce ITC (reported as reversal / net-off in 3B Table 4).
